summary: Fortis Inc. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the execution of Second and Third Supplemental Indentures dated September 21, 2026, among the registrant, The Bank of New York Mellon as U.S. trustee, and Computershare Advantage Trust of Canada as Canadian co-trustee. The Second Supplemental Indenture establishes 6.625% Fixed-to-Fixed Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057, including subordination, redemption and dividend-stopper provisions; exhibits are incorporated by reference into the Form F-10 shelf registration. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, premium or change of control is disclosed; this is a routine debt-securities supplemental indenture filing. Watch for pricing terms, size and use of proceeds in subsequent filings.
